hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -q "git commit"; then echo "⚠️ PRE-COMMIT: Ensure CHANGELOG.md updated, Sprint-Log.md reflects progress, conventional commit message" >&2; fi'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -q "git push"; then echo "📋 POST-PUSH: Sync GitHub Wiki! cd /tmp && ([ -d ideate.wiki ] || git clone https://github.com/dobrician/ideate.wiki.git) && cp /home/dc/work/ideate/docs/wiki/*.md /tmp/ideate.wiki/ && cd /tmp/ideate.wiki && git add -A && git diff --cached --quiet || (git commit -m docs:sync-wiki && git push)" >&2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -q "docker compose up"; then echo "🧪 POST-DEPLOY: Run smoke tests! npm run test:smoke" >&2; fi'
echo '✅ DONE — Verify: 1) CHANGELOG.md updated 2) Sprint-Log.md tasks checked off 3) Wiki synced 4) Tests passing 5) README.md accurate 6) Issues referenced' >&2
